title: Month-end contribution reconciliation

steps.title: Open Remittances and filter to October, unreconciled
Compare the schedule total with the amount received
Run auto-match on the member lines
Exclude the leaver's line from the schedule
Post the contributions to member accounts
Record a note explaining the variance

decisions: If the variance is M$50 or less, accept it and record a note; if it is over M$50, find the member line that explains it.

If the unmatched member has left the employer, exclude the line as a leaver; if the member is still active, raise an employer query from Actions and do not post until the employer pays the difference.
warnings: Always amend the schedule before posting: posting locks the period, and reversing it needs a Treasury ticket and a second approver.
openQuestions: The exact posting cut-off time this quarter (third working day): Corinne will confirm it with Treasury.
